title: Neko focus tabs
description: A pinned, scroll-told feature tour on a lemon wash. A white card fills the window (it grows from an inset card to full bleed as it arrives); a tall picture on the left (on top on phones) and, on the right, a row of capitalised tabs over a big soft-serif headline, a short paragraph and an arrow link. Scrolling slides each next picture up over the last, cross-fades the text with every word rising into place, and darkens the active tab (phones also fill an underline under it).
notes: about (tabs + 1.25) screens tall on desktop, (tabs + 1.7) on phones; works with 2 to 6 tabs
the tabs are links to markers down the section, so clicking one scrolls to its panel without JavaScript
pure CSS scroll-driven; without scroll timelines or with reduced motion it becomes a plain stack of cards
